title: Erdős–Straus conjecture
statement: For every integer n >= 2, the Diophantine equation 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z has a solution in positive integers x, y, z.
why_interesting: Famous open Egyptian-fraction conjecture with computational evidence but no proof.
still_open_evidence: Listed as unsolved; only verified computationally for large bounds.

title: Unit fraction representation of 4/n
statement: Prove that for every integer n >= 2 there exist positive integers x, y, z such that 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z (the Erdos-Straus equation).
why_interesting: Same equation, reworded as a unit-fraction representation question.
